run as the same Windows user and integrity level as the CAD app.** This is not a cloud service "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"and there
is no headless substitute for native `.dwg` / `.sldprt` output."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Two skills are the entry points. They load lazily — the SKILL.md is read only when a request matches"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" its

| `autocad-mcp-pro` | Author"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ed here (upstream ships no AutoCAD skill).
